name: Minnesota

words.means: Oof: for surprise, dismay, relief or exhaustion. A Scandinavian import.
words.use: Uff da, that was a rough fourth quarter.

words.means: Yes, sure, no problem.

words.means: Expensive.

name: St. Louis and Kansas City

words.use: Take Highway 40 downtown to the ballpark.

words.means: Toasted ravioli: breaded, fried and dunked in marinara. A St. Louis invention.

words.means: The soft white processed cheese on St. Louis-style pizza.
